blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Lucio Tan-led LT Group Inc. posted a record attributable net income of P25.82 billion in the first nine months of 2026, up 14 percent from P22.57 billion a year ago, as its banking and tobacco businesses drove earnings growth. Philippine National Bank (PNB) was the biggest contributor at P11.95 billion, or 46 percent of the total.
